lines.text: Nvidia took in $1.27 billion a day.
lines.say: Nvidia took in one point two seven billion dollars a day.

lines.text: That's sales, not profit: $115.8 billion over a 91-day quarter, reported last night.
lines.say: That's sales, not profit: one hundred fifteen point eight billion dollars over a ninety-one-day quarter, reported last night.

lines.text: The same quarter a year ago was $57 billion, so sales more than doubled.
lines.say: The same quarter a year ago was fifty-seven billion, so sales more than doubled.

lines.text: Profit more than doubled too, from $31.9 billion to $65.3 billion.
lines.say: Profit more than doubled too, from thirty-one point nine billion dollars to sixty-five point three billion.

lines.text: Why should you care? If you own an S&P 500 fund, Nvidia is about 6% of it.
lines.say: Why should you care? If you own an S and P five hundred fund, Nvidia is about six percent of it.

lines.text: That means for every $100 in that fund, about $6 rides on this one company.
lines.say: That means for every one hundred dollars in that fund, about six dollars rides on this one company.

lines.text: Nvidia's own forecast for next quarter is $130 billion, give or take 3%.
lines.say: Nvidia's own forecast for next quarter is one hundred thirty billion, give or take three percent.

lines.text: The takeaway: an index fund holds 500 companies, but a few giants steer it. Know what's inside yours.
lines.say: The takeaway: an index fund holds five hundred companies, but a few giants steer it. Know what's inside yours.

post.title: Nvidia took in $1.27 billion a day. Why your fund cares
post.ig:
Nvidia took in $1.27 billion a day last quarter (our math: $115.8B over 91 days).
Revenue hit $115.8 billion for the quarter ended Oct 25, up 103% from $57.0B a year ago (Nvidia, Nov 17).
Profit rose to $65.3 billion from $31.9 billion. Nvidia's own forecast for next quarter: $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.
Nvidia is about 6% of the S&P 500, so about $6 of every $100 in an S&P 500 fund rides on it.
Sources: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 release and CFO commentary (SEC 8-K, Nov 17), CNBC, Carson Group via Yahoo Finance.
